landing.heroBody: ScholarBridge matches you with the right universities and scholarships based on your GPA, IELTS score and budget — then helps you write a winning application, with AI at every step.
landing.enterApp: Already have a profile? Enter the app →
landing.howSubtitle: From first profile to funded admission — in three simple steps.
landing.step1Text: Tell us your name, email, GPA, test scores and budget — takes less than 2 minutes, step by step.
landing.step2Text: Our engine matches you against universities and scholarships based on your real academic profile.
landing.step3Text: Track applications, write your SOP with AI help and land grants that cover your studies.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to study abroad
landing.featuresSubtitle: One platform for research, applications, funding and community.
landing.f1Text: Find universities that fit your GPA, IELTS score, budget and major — with an automatic Reach / Match / Safety rating for every option.
landing.f2Text: Discover grants and scholarships you're actually eligible for: DAAD, Chevening, Erasmus Mundus, Fulbright and hundreds more.
landing.f3Text: Generate, evaluate and polish your Statement of Purpose with AI guidance at every step — even if you've never written one before.
landing.f4Text: Step-by-step video lessons on applications, visas and funding, with quizzes and certificates to track your progress.
landing.f5Text: Ask questions, share experience and connect with other students who are applying abroad right now.
landing.f6Text: Invite friends and earn premium access — 30 days of Premium for every 5 friends who join and complete their profile.
landing.trustTitle: Your dream university is closer than you think
landing.trustText: Join thousands of students who found their path abroad. Create your profile in 2 minutes — matching is completely free.
landing.footerLeft: ScholarBridge AI — Global Admissions & Scholarship Discovery
landing.footerRight: Free profile matching · Premium unlocks AI SOP, Courses, Forum & more
